description: This file defines a PIDRateEstimator class used in Spark Streaming to estimate data ingestion rates using a PID controller. It includes configuration parameters, internal state management, and a compute method for rate calculation based on batch processing metrics.

classes.name: PIDRateEstimator
classes.description: A class implementing a PID controller to estimate data ingestion rate in Spark Streaming, considering proportional, integral, and derivative components, with safeguards for minimum rate and batch interval validation.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Calculates the estimated data processing rate based on current batch metrics, applying PID control logic, and returns an optional double representing the rate.
